items.title: A Basic attack's Critical: 1d10! of a type you choose, or none
items.do: Kaela: Weapon Attack on a Goblin Sneak until a Critical (force it: the roll dialog's Tier "Critical", if you use it); roll the damage. Then Aveline's Weapon Attack with a Critical, and once press "Don't apply".
items.expect: before the damage, the bar asks "a Critical! Its 1d10!: choose the damage type" with one button per type the Action deals ("[V] 1d10! Pi") and "Don't apply"; the chosen die is added to the damage card (exploding); "Don't apply" deals a plain Tier 3. A Critical on a non-Basic Action with no Critical row (Smite) asks nothing.

items.title: Trip's and Shove's Critical rows
items.do: Durgan: Shove a Goblin Sneak with a Critical; Trip it (1 AP, then 2 AP) with a Critical.
items.expect: the cards show a "Critical" row under Tier 3 (Shove: Prone; Trip: [V] 1d6! Bl). On the Critical the bar asks "Apply: Prone" / "Apply: [V] 1d6! Bl." or "Don't apply"; Shove's Prone lands with the push; Trip 1 AP's 1d6! comes as a small damage card ("Trip: Critical") to Apply; Trip 2 AP adds it to its Tier 3 damage.

items.title: Bloodied: Speed −2 and Steadiness −1 (below 0)
items.do: Orc Warrior: deal it damage until it is Bloodied (its Vigor). Look at its Speed (sheet, Advance); then Durgan Shoves it (Pushed 1). Then heal it above the threshold.
items.expect: Bloodied, its Speed is 2 lower (a Hindered one: lowered first, then halved); Durgan's Shove 1 moves it 2 (Steadiness −1; no question asked); healed, Speed and pushes are back to normal.

items.title: Strained: no Reaction Point at the start of the turn
items.do: Aveline: Resolve damage until she is Strained, with her Reaction Point spent; let her next turn start. Then once with it unspent.
items.expect: spent, it stays spent at the start of her turn (the gold diamond empty); unspent, she keeps it; kept AP still pay Reactions; healed below the threshold, she regains it from her next turn. The texts say "Reaction Point" (sheet, HUD, roll dialog).

items.title: A card's Bloodied line (the Ogre's placeholder)
items.do: Ogre Chieftain: Overhead Smash on Durgan, once when Durgan is far from Bloodied, once when this hit makes him Bloodied (Tier 2 or 3).
items.expect: the card shows "Bloodied: On a Tier 2 or 3, the target is Pushed 1 more." under the Tiers; the first time only Pushed 2; the second, after the damage lands and the Push 2, a Push 1 more runs.
